description: Unit tests for the PathBuilder component in the net::cert::pki namespace, specifically testing PKITS (Public Key Infrastructure Testing) scenarios related to certificate path validation, revocation, distribution points, delta CRLs, and other certificate validation features.

classes.name: CrlCheckingPathBuilderDelegate
classes.description: A delegate class for path building that performs CRL revocation checks during path verification.

classes.name: PathBuilderPkitsTestDelegate
classes.description: A test delegate class that sets up certificate chains, trust anchors, and revocation data for PKITS test scenarios and runs path validation tests.

methods.name: CheckPathAfterVerification
methods.description: Performs revocation checks on certificates in the path after initial verification.

methods.name: RunTest
methods.description: Sets up and executes a PKITS test scenario, including certificate chain creation, trust store setup, and path validation.
